exceptions.interpretation: The reference-distribution artifact was regenerated after the v3 manifest was written, and the manifest output entry was not refreshed.
exceptions.impact: The stale entry affects provenance validation for this single v3 artifact. Seed row counts and the v3 manifest file itself are unchanged. The v4 parent_manifest_sha256 chain remains valid, and all v4 output hashes match their artifacts.
exceptions.resolution: Keep historical manifests byte-for-byte unchanged. Apply the corrected reference baseline from the v4 release and retain this explicit exception record.
